name: ui-draft
description: A shadcn component and its demo page, written from a page-record recording of the original, and revised from a page-diff of the last draft. Never sees the original's code.

verbs.name: write
verbs.description: Write one draft of a component from how the original looks and moves in a recording, in one model call. Pass the last draft, its page-diff, and any install or typecheck error to revise it. Cached by every input's content, the model, and the prompt hash. Refuses with budget_exceeded once today's model spend reaches the daily budget.

recording.description: recording.json of a page-record capture of the original. Its steps file is read too.

name.description: The registry item's name, such as input-otp-rebuild. The component goes to components/ui/<name>.tsx.

previous.description: A ui-draft JSON file from the last round, to revise.

diff.description: A page-diff JSON file comparing the original to the last round's rebuild.

problem.description: Free text, such as the install or typecheck error the last draft hit.

packages.description: Comma-separated npm packages the target project already has. The draft depends only on these.
